basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal), through the Office of the Dean, Faculty Affairs, has announced 1 vacancy for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF) post under advertisement number IISERB/DoFA/2026/30. how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure I) from the official notification.
Prepare the completed application form in PDF format, your latest Curriculum Vitae (CV), a comprehensive list of publications, and a detailed research plan for one year (maximum two pages).
Attach a scanned copy of your Ph.D. Degree certificate or Ph.D. Thesis submission receipt if the degree is yet to be awarded.
Send all documents via email to [email protected] on or before 13 November 2026.
Mention the subject line explicitly as "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (DSE)".

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal
Rs. 67,000/- per month + HRA (Rs. 35,000/- per month + HRA for thesis-submitted candidates awaiting degree)
Preference for candidates below 35 years as on the last date of submission

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields from a recognized Institute or University. Ph.D. scholars who have submitted their thesis are also eligible to apply, provided they submit their provisional or degree certificate within six months from the date of appointment. Preference is given to candidates below 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on satisfactory performance. The fellowship is Rs. 67,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per Institute rules. Candidates who have submitted their thesis and are awaiting the award of their Ph.D. degree or provisional degree will be paid a reduced fellowship of Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA. Once the Ph.D. degree is submitted, the full fellowship of Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA will be restored effective from the date of award of the degree or provisional certificate. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF)
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure I) from the official notification. Prepare the completed application form in PDF format, your latest Curriculum Vitae (CV), a comprehensive list of publications, and a detailed research plan for one year (maximum two pages). Attach a scanned copy of your Ph.D. Degree certificate or Ph.D. Thesis submission receipt if the degree is yet to be awarded. Send all documents via email to [email protected] on or before 13 November 2026. Mention the subject line explicitly as "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (DSE)" .

faq.question: Q1. What is the contract duration for the IISER Bhopal IPDF post?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. What fellowship is paid if the Ph.D. degree is awaited?
faq.answer: Candidates who have submitted their thesis and are awaiting the award of their Ph.D. degree receive a reduced fellowship of Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA until the degree or provisional certificate is submitted.

faq.question: Q3. What age limit applies to the IPDF position?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates below 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the correct email subject line for submitting the application?
faq.answer: The subject line must be mentioned as "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (DSE)".

faq.question: Q5. Is accommodation provided by the institute?
faq.answer: No accommodation will be provided to the IPDFs.
